notes: Capability/agent model card (arXiv 2603.20633v3), not a full safety system card. Figure 10 (AIR-Bench, XSTest) and Figures 1–4 efficiency charts have no reliable numeric table extract—skipped chart-only points except prose numbers on p.10–11. Table vs prose score conflicts (GAIA 87.4 vs 93.2; BrowseComp-zh 81.3 vs 78.5; FinSearchComp 62.8 vs 56.2; TOMATO 60.8 vs 60.6)—table values used for evalResults. ScreenSpot-Pro Seed1.8 recorded as both 64.3 (base) and 73.1 (crop-box). LiveCodeBench pro treated as rating/score (Elo-like), not percent. WorldTravel reported as Bo5 per footnote. No external testers or formal risk-tier decisions stated. Capped evalResults at 600 (dropped trailing prose efficiency numbers for BrowseComp effort modes and EMMA NoThink after Table 7).
